Name: Bambuck as barn animals for CP
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]
Turns Bambuck from Core Keeper into barn animals!

Can be one of four color variants: Red, Blue, Pink and Grey.

Using a milk pail on mature Bambuck will give you Bambuck milk.



[img]https://abload.de/img/pets6efch.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://abload.de/img/buttons1jtd.png[/img]﻿

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿.
3. Download and unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.[/center]

Downloads.Description: Fixed the animals getting stuck and not going back inside at night
